base_control: null fraction disables partial exit and must reproduce source metrics exactly
cost_policy: retain the calibrated full-position all-in cost because entry notional is 100% and weighted partial plus final exit notional sums to 100%; no unmeasured maker rebate or extra order-level benefit is assumed

partial_rule: pre-place a reduce-only partial target at entry_reference + 1.0 * planned_risk; if original stop and partial target are both touched in one 5m bar, apply stop-first; after partial fill keep the original stop and 2.0R final target unchanged for the remainder
sequence_warning: Any partial-exit candidate that passes must be rerun with same-symbol position-sequence enforcement before W1.
